title: Sinuosity
summary: SINUOS'ITY, noun [Latin sinuosus, sinus.] The quality of bending or curving in and out; or a series of bends and turns in arches or other irregular figures.

inlines.v: SINUOS'ITY, noun [Latin sinuosus, sinus.] The quality of bending or curving in and out; or a series of bends and turns in arches or other irregular figures.
